bio.text: Betty Villegas, a Democrat from Tucson, represents Legislative District 20 in the Arizona House of Representatives; the Pima County Board of Supervisors appointed her in July 2023 to fill the seat vacated by Andrés Cano.
She is a former Pima County supervisor and a housing advocate, and she retired from Pima County government in 2016 as Housing Program Manager for Community Development and Neighborhood Conservation.
The Arizona Mirror describes her as a life-long Tucson resident, and in 2026 she is seeking re-election to the House in Legislative District 20.
